questions.question_text:
Based only on the conversation below, identify the logically correct inference:
“Even if I had known that you were in the hospital, I would not have gone there to
see you”, Ramya told Josephine.

options.A: Ramya knew that Josephine was in the hospital.
options.B: Ramya did not know that Josephine was in the hospital.
options.C: Ramya and Josephine were once close friends; but now, they are not.
options.D:
Josephine was in the hospital due to an injury to her leg.

Organising Institute: IIT Roorkee

questions.explaination: The subjunctive statement 'Even if I had known that you were in the hospital...' logically presupposes that the speaker did not know about Josephine's hospitalization at that time.

questions.question_text:
If IMAGE and FIELD are coded as FHBNJ and EMFJG respectively then, which
one among the given options is the most appropriate code for BEACH ?
questions.explaination: The coding rule applies a $+1$ alphabetical shift to each character followed by string reversal. Shifting $\text{BEACH}$ by $+1$ gives $\text{CFBDI}$, and reversing this yields $\text{IDBFC}$.
questions.question_text_latex: If $\text{IMAGE}$ and $\text{FIELD}$ are coded as $\text{FHBNJ}$ and $\text{EMFJG}$ respectively then, which one among the given options is the most appropriate code for $\text{BEACH}$?

options.D:
𝑋(𝑖) = 𝑋(𝑖−1) + 𝐼(𝑖); 𝑌(𝑖) = 𝑌(𝑖−1)𝐼(𝑖−1); 𝑖> 0

Organising Institute: IIT Roorkee

questions.explaination: Check the sequence updates: $X(i) = X(i-1) + I(i)$ yields $20 + (-4) = 16, 16 + 10 = 26, 26 + 15 = 41$, and $Y(i) = Y(i-1) \cdot I(i)$ yields $20 \times (-4) = -80, -80 \times 10 = -800, -800 \times 15 = -12000$.
